red_flags: Public announcement treated as financing close
LOI treated as binding demand without volume, term, pricing, or budget-owner evidence
Vendor marketing treated as delivery commitment
Tax, customs, or incentive benefit assumed without a supporting memo or official source
Export-control, supply-chain, or end-use restrictions treated as solved without counsel or compliance review
Site or power capacity treated as available without allocation, interconnection, cooling, and commissioning evidence
RFP shortlist built from incomplete or non-comparable proposals
Financing pipeline treated as committed capital
Risk register lists meetings instead of owner actions, mitigations, and evidence required
do_not_claim_without: project bankability without demand, procurement, financing, site, and regulatory evidence
financial close without signed financing documents or lender-confirmed conditions
binding demand without signed or near-binding customer evidence
deliverable procurement without vendor, OEM, integrator, supply-chain, and restriction evidence
tax or customs benefit without source-backed treatment and owner review
FID readiness without a committee-ready risk register and unresolved-blocker list
freshness_rules: Vendor pricing, delivery timing, financing terms, and export-control posture are volatile; treat stale sources as partial support.
Public announcements should be paired with current project documents before committee or lender review.
LOIs and financing correspondence require date, signatory status, scope, conditions, and binding/non-binding label.
Tax, customs, and regulatory assumptions require current source date and explicit owner review status.
watch_indicators: export-control rule or license posture change
